value.rationale: The natural experimental object is a harmonic colloid driven by periodically reversing circulation. The theorem supplies an all-time visibility boundary for hidden rotational dissipation: a complete reversible position path can carry memory/non-Gaussian two-time structure and coexist with positive fully observed fixed-label entropy. The radial law is even identical to equilibrium at the process level, while covariance curvature supports model-conditional torque inference. These are structural and experimentally interpretable diagnostics, not arbitrary parameter slices or textbook zero-current calculations.
